summary: Phase 1: Multi-project data layer - database schema, migration, and project CRUD

budget_impact.rationale: Data layer changes only; no new model calls. Multi-project structure enables future per-project recommendations without changing token budget.
budget_impact.before: Single project with global profile, papers, and feedback
budget_impact.after: Multiple projects with isolated profiles, papers, and feedback per project. Migration creates default project for existing data.

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; multi-project isolation and migration review

open_risks: Migration is idempotent but automatic on first app start after upgrade
No UI for project selection yet - existing users will use default project until Phase 2
update_project and delete_project deferred to Phase 2
Weekly reports and profile snapshots schema created but not yet used
